page.title: Publishing
page.subtitle: Publish finished videos to your accounts now or on a schedule, and see everything that was published.

dialog.title: Publish “{{title}}”
dialog.onPlatform: {{platform}} publishes at that time itself – Polixor doesn't need to be running.
dialog.onPolixor: Polixor publishes to {{platform}} at that time – the Polixor server must be running then (a VPS, cloud server or a computer that stays on).
dialog.sandboxNote: Sandbox account – nothing is really published.
dialog.madeForKidsHint: Required by YouTube. Tick it only if the video is made for children.
dialog.synthetic: Contains realistic AI-generated or altered content
dialog.syntheticHint: YouTube asks creators to disclose realistic content that was generated or changed with AI (for example an AI image that looks real).
dialog.coverAtHint: Instagram uses this moment of the video as the cover. Leave empty to let Instagram choose.

queue.empty: Nothing published yet. Open a finished clip and choose Publish.
queue.serverOnline: The Polixor server must be running at that time.
queue.schedulerOff: The publishing scheduler isn't running on this server, so scheduled posts won't go out. Check POLIXOR_SCHEDULER.

accounts.title: Connected accounts
accounts.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect {{name}}? Its access is revoked and posts scheduled by Polixor for it are cancelled. Already published posts stay.
accounts.sandboxHint: For testing the flow. Nothing is published anywhere.
accounts.neverPassword: Polixor never asks for your social media password. Accounts connect through the platform's own sign-in page.
accounts.metaShared: One Facebook sign-in connects your Pages and the Instagram accounts linked to them.

apps.title: Developer apps
apps.subtitle: Each platform needs your own developer app. The secret stays on the server and is never shown again.
apps.redirect: Redirect URI to register with the platform

errors.oauth_state: The connection link expired or was already used. Try connecting again.
errors.oauth_denied: The connection was cancelled on the platform.
errors.oauth_failed: Connecting the account failed. Try again.
errors.platform_unavailable: Publishing to this platform isn't available yet.
errors.meta_no_pages: No Facebook Page you can post to was found. Select a Page in Facebook's permission window.
errors.meta_no_instagram: No Instagram professional account linked to a Facebook Page was found. Your Pages were connected; link Instagram to a Page and connect again.
errors.scope_missing: Not all required permissions were approved. Connect again and approve them.
errors.youtube_no_channel: This Google account has no YouTube channel.

tiktok.creatorFailed: Couldn't load the TikTok account details. Try again.
tiktok.discloseHint: Turn on to disclose that this video promotes goods or services in exchange for something of value.
tiktok.yourBrandHint: You are promoting yourself or your own business.
tiktok.brandedHint: You are promoting another brand or a third party. Branded content can't be set to Only me.
tiktok.labelPromo: Your video will be labeled “Promotional content”.
tiktok.labelPaid: Your video will be labeled “Paid partnership”.
tiktok.consent: By posting, you agree to TikTok's
tiktok.consentBranded: By posting, you agree to TikTok's Branded Content Policy and
tiktok.processing: After publishing, it may take a few minutes for the video to appear on your TikTok profile.

metadata.hint: From what's said in this clip, per platform. You can edit everything.
metadata.fromAi: Suggested by AI from the clip's transcript. Check it before publishing.
metadata.fromRules: Suggested from the clip's title and transcript.
metadata.caption: Caption
